reviews.summary: TREAD is a very recent token launch (September 16, 2026). Current circulating-supply/unlock data are materially inconsistent across trackers, creating elevated distribution and liquidity uncertainty for this TREAD-EUR entry.
materialRisks: Newly launched asset: Kraken states TREAD trading went live on September 16, 2026—only 12 days before this snapshot—so the market has limited trading history and can face launch-phase liquidity/distribution instability. ([blog.kraken.com](https://blog.kraken.com/product/asset-listings/tread-is-available-for-trading?utm_source=openai))

Supply/unlock ambiguity: Tokenomist reports about 18.53% unlocked, while CoinMarketCap displays a self-reported 100% circulating supply and separately describes 23.8% circulating at launch. This unresolved discrepancy is directly relevant to potential sellable supply. ([tokenomist.ai](https://tokenomist.ai/tread-fi/unlock-events?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: Kraken announced TREAD trading live on September 16, 2026, and describes a fixed 100 million-token supply with no mint function. ([blog.kraken.com](https://blog.kraken.com/product/asset-listings/tread-is-available-for-trading?utm_source=openai))

Kraken’s status page lists TREAD on Ethereum as operational; no current exchange-side outage was found in the checked status source. ([status.kraken.com](https://status.kraken.com/?utm_source=openai))

Tread’s own status page reported all monitored services online, last updated September 24, 2026; no scheduled maintenance was listed for September. ([status.tread.io](https://status.tread.io/?utm_source=openai))
No fresh, corroborated exploit, hack, delisting, or regulatory action specific to tread.fi/TREAD was found in the reviewed sources.
